title: OL-20261114-3: ROLE-WORK-2: waiting dispatches need the Worker-native executor
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** finding needs-executor on /api/v1/status
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/nativeexec.js::export async function runDbQueue
**Status:** closed

Items whose probe needs a code change wait with dispatch status waiting until nativeexec takes them (docs/issues/ROLE-WORK-2.json).

**Evidence:** Already built as CODE-QUEUE-1: runDbQueue in seed/worker/src/nativeexec.js takes needs-code items from the Worker database with no session. Done check corrected to the function that does it.
